name: monarch
description: Multi-agent desktop command center for AI coding agents, built on Tauri, Svelte 5, and Rust.
author: Miha Bubnjevic

scripts.build: npm run build:sidecar && npm run build:web
scripts.pi:upgrade: npm install @mariozechner/pi-ai@latest @mariozechner/pi-coding-agent@latest && npm install --prefix sidecar @mariozechner/pi-ai@latest @mariozechner/pi-coding-agent@latest && npm run build:sidecar
